order_placed.title: {order_type} Order placed
order_placed.description: Limit {order_type} for {rwa_token_amount} {token_symbol} at {price_per_rwa_token} {quote_token_symbol}. {total_usd_value_of_rwa_token_amount} {quote_token_symbol} held in escrow. Order #{order_id}.

order_partially_filled.title: {order_type} Order partially filled

order_filled.title: {order_type} Order fully filled

order_canceled.title: {order_type} Order canceled
order_canceled.description: Your {order_type} order for {rwa_token_amount} {token_symbol} was canceled. {refunded_amount} {quote_token_symbol} released from escrow to your wallet. Order #{order_id}.

order_closed._comment: No full description in Notification Text - Equiteez.docx. PDF copy hint: Order closed, funds claimable.

order_refunded.title: Order funds refunded
order_refunded.description: {refunded_amount} {quote_token_symbol} from order #{order_id} has been returned to your available balance.

tokens_received.title: Deposit Received
tokens_received.description: {amount} {token_symbol} received from {from}. Available in your wallet now.

tokens_sent.title: Tokens sent
tokens_sent.description: {amount} {token_symbol} sent to {to}. Transaction {operation_hash}. Didn't make this transfer? Contact Equiteez support immediately.

tokens_burned.title: Tokens debited (burn)
tokens_burned.description: {amount} {token_symbol} debited from your wallet. Transaction {operation_hash}. Questions? Contact Equiteez support.

launch_tokens_distributed.title: Launch tokens distributed
